content.text: Formed in 2013 to source and manage investments for our founder’s capital. Expanded to offer investors access to unique investments encompassing both a perpetual portfolio of seasoned assets, as well as single investment sidecar opportunities. Focus on income producing commercial real estate assets and unique or opportunistic development projects. Investments span the capital stack: - senior debt - mezzanine debt - preferred equity - limited partner and JV equity
